name: dataset-srj33-drc-failures
selection: Retain the 12 original samples with positive DRC counts in the supplied Pipeline 9 benchmark, then add deduplicated bug-report SRJs that complete routing with at least one DRC issue in the additional Blacksmith verification. Original sample IDs are preserved; additions start at sample032. See pipeline9Filter and additionalAudit for the exact measurements and pinned revisions.

samples.issueTitle: Autorouter emits overlapping GPIO35/PSRAM vias causing a deterministic short

Per-connection trace widths are ignored: 1.0 mm motor traces emit as 0.15 mm

pipeline9Filter.criterion: Pipeline 9 snapshot drcErrorCount > 0; preserve original sample IDs

additionalAudit.criterion: solved && !failed && traceCount > 0 && drcErrorCount > 0; inputs deduplicated against all 31 original SRJs and within this batch
